approved_contract: All 34 immutable prediction artifacts from all five completed and independently reviewed source groups are included; no completed family or diagnostic control is omitted.
The comparator requires byte-exact reports, outcome reviews, predictions and forward slot reports, then recomputes each saved metric on one identical 1,219-row validation cohort.
Three-seed families are averaged at row, horizon and quantile level before monotone rearrangement and scoring; no best seed is selected.
Every candidate is compared with the fixed direct-neural three-seed ensemble using the frozen 48-hour, 2,000-draw, seed-20260926 paired bootstrap.
Controls remain labelled diagnostic, post-hoc arms remain labelled post-hoc, and the output status is neutral with model selection explicitly not performed.
The composite digest binds the comparison runner, the pure AEON evaluator and the saved-row integrity reader.

independent_execution.metadata_only_source_precheck: Loaded all five exact reports and independent outcome reviews and verified their schemas, statuses and lineage before opening any forecast array for this comparison review.
independent_execution.byte_hash_inventory: Independently verified all 49 file hashes named by the frozen input manifest without decoding the forecast arrays.

execution_conditions: Run the comparator exactly once against the approved input and this approval artifact; any input, code or source digest change invalidates this approval.
Preserve the full neutral report before applying ADR 0010's separately frozen selection rule.
Obtain independent outcome review of exact score, support, ensemble and bootstrap reconstruction before numerical calibration access.
scientific_limits: The comparison uses development validation data and carries selection-induced optimism.
The forward and Chronos arms are post-hoc extensions; the core selection rule was also frozen late and is not confirmatory.
This approval does not establish SOTA, external generalization, calibrated absolute backscatter, biological causality or production value.
